description_en: Queries the list of Elastic Network Interface (ENI) permissions that you have granted to an Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) or an individual user
description_zh: 调用DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions查询您授权给阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）或者个人用户的弹性网卡权限列表
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-network-interface-permissions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-interface-id eni-bp17pdijfczax0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --network-interface-permission-id eni-perm-bp1cs4lwn56lfb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions

parameters.help_en: The region of the network interface controller (NIC) permissions. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡权限的地域。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC). You must specify `NetworkInterfaceId` or `NetworkInterfacePermissionId.N` to determine the query scope
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡ID。您必须指定`NetworkInterfaceId`或`NetworkInterfacePermissionId.N`确定查询范围
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the network interface controller (NIC) permission list.

Minimum value: 1

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡权限列表的页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for the paged query.

Maximum value: 100

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of network interface controller (NIC) permission IDs. Number of elements in the list: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡权限ID列表。列表元素数量：1~100
parameters.name: network_interface_permission_id

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
